name: POW
description: Returns the base raised to the power of the exponent.

parameters.name: exponent
parameters.description: Exponent. Must be an integer literal, not a column reference.

examples.title: Square a number
examples.sql: SELECT POW(radius, 2) * PI as area FROM circles

examples.title: Raise a column to a fixed power
examples.description: A stored rate raised to a fixed exponent
examples.sql: SELECT POW(rate, 3) AS growth_factor FROM investments

notes: The exponent must be an integer literal: POW(rate, 3) is accepted, POW(rate, years) is not
Arithmetic is not accepted in either argument: POW(1 + rate, 3) is rejected
